$comment: Island amenities built from their spaces (Wiki: Island amenity and each amenity's page: level, XP, materials; a hammer and a saw for all). Each site is one varbit by gameval: 0 shows the space (Build, Inspect), 1 the built amenity, and for a rowboat also its mainland twin (the _in multiloc, hidden at 0). Each site's loc is its base multiloc at the space. Built amenities work through the plugins that own their kind by name: a range (Cooking pot), Spinning wheel, Loom, Potter's wheel, Pottery oven, Anvil, Furnace, Bank chest (Bank, Collect), a water source (Water pump); rowboats are ferries routes (plugins/world/data/ferries.json, rowboat-*). Sangvesti's bank chest is the same amenity under its own loc (Wiki: Bank chest (amenity)); Wyrmscraig's chest pieces are not an amenity. Not captured: human_poh_build on the build, as the house's hotspots play it, and the messages are ours. {name} is the amenity with its article, {level} its level, {materials} its materials as text.

messages.inspect: You could build {name} here with level {level} Construction, a hammer, a saw, {materials}.
messages.level: You need a Construction level of {level} to build {name}.
messages.tools: You need a hammer and a saw to build {name}.
